info.title: CogniaWerks API
info.description: CogniaWerks REST API. Every error response uses the ErrorEnvelope schema.

get.summary: Searches the audit trail of the caller's tenant, newest first. Permission `ReadAudit`.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Earliest event time (inclusive, converted to UTC).

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Latest event time (exclusive, converted to UTC).

parameters.name: Actor
parameters.description: The subject identifier of the actor.

parameters.name: EntityType
parameters.description: The kind of object, for example `Membership`.

parameters.name: EntityId
parameters.description: The identifier of the object.

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: The action name, for example `Edit` or `AccessDenied` (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: CorrelationId
parameters.description: The correlation ID of the request that caused the events.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items; `null` uses the configured default.

parameters.name: Cursor
parameters.description: The opaque cursor returned as `nextCursor` by the previous page; `null` for the first page.

post.summary:
Exports the filtered audit trail of the caller's tenant as a CSV or JSON file, streamed in chronological order.
Permission `ExportAudit` and a role allowed by the tenant's export policy for `audit`. More than
50,000 matching events give 422 `EXPORT_TOO_LARGE`. The export is recorded as `Export` audit event
with filter, row count and the SHA-256 of the file.

requestBody.description: Token that is cancelled when the client disconnects.

get.summary: Gets the effective export policy, one entry per export type; types that were never configured show their default.

put.summary:
Sets the export policy of the listed export types. A role that does not hold the export permission of the type
is refused with 422 `EXPORT_ROLE_NOT_PERMITTED`: the policy can narrow the permission matrix, never widen it.

requestBody.description: Token that is cancelled when the client disconnects.

get.summary: Lists the known feature flags with their state for the current tenant (names and on/off only).

Gets the security and privacy figures of the caller's tenant: memberships per role, refused requests, credential
references per network status, retention settings and exports. Administrators only (permission `Administer`).

Gets the readiness of the API, the database, the data provider per network of the caller's tenant and the job
host. Administrators and platform operators (permission `ViewServiceHealth`); a read by a platform operator
is recorded in the platform trail.
Lists the memberships of the caller's tenant with their grants, ordered by subject.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items; `null` uses the configured default.

parameters.name: Cursor
parameters.description: The opaque cursor returned as `nextCursor` by the previous page; `null` for the first page.

post.summary: Adds a membership (subject and role) to the caller's tenant. Honours `Idempotency-Key`.

requestBody.description: Token that is cancelled when the client disconnects.

get.summary: Gets one membership with its grants; the response carries its ETag.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The membership identifier.

put.summary:
Changes the role of a membership. Requires `If-Match`. Taking the role from the last active
Administrator is refused with 409 `LAST_ADMIN`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The membership identifier.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the version being changed, as returned by the API.

requestBody.description: Token that is cancelled when the client disconnects.

post.summary:
Disables a membership; the member is refused from its next request on. Requires `If-Match` and honours
`Idempotency-Key`. Disabling the last active Administrator is refused with 409 `LAST_ADMIN`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The membership identifier.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the version being changed, as returned by the API.

post.summary: Adds a scope grant (tenant, site or asset) to a membership. Honours `Idempotency-Key`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The membership identifier.

requestBody.description: Token that is cancelled when the client disconnects.

delete.summary: Removes a scope grant from a membership.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The membership identifier.

parameters.name: grantId
parameters.description: The grant identifier.

get.summary: Lists the networks of the caller's tenant, ordered by external network identifier.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items; `null` uses the configured default.

parameters.name: Cursor
parameters.description: The opaque cursor returned as `nextCursor` by the previous page; `null` for the first page.

post.summary:
Registers a network. Honours `Idempotency-Key`. Endpoint rules are refused with 422 (for example
`INSECURE_ENDPOINT`, `ENDPOINT_NOT_ALLOWLISTED`, `BLOCKED_ENDPOINT`); activating the live provider
while its feature flag is off gives 422 `FEATURE_DISABLED`; a duplicate identifier gives 409 `NETWORK_EXISTS`.

requestBody.description: Token that is cancelled when the client disconnects.

get.summary: Gets one network; the response carries its ETag.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The network identifier.

put.summary:
Replaces the settings of a network (the external identifier stays). Requires `If-Match`. The same endpoint
and activation rules as for registration apply.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The network identifier.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the version being changed, as returned by the API.

requestBody.description: Token that is cancelled when the client disconnects.

post.summary: Disables a network. Requires `If-Match` and honours `Idempotency-Key`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The network identifier.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the version being changed, as returned by the API.

put.summary:
Sets or replaces the credential reference of a network. Requires `If-Match` (the network's ETag). The
reference is stored, not resolved, and is never returned; the response only shows `hasCredentialRef`.
A reference outside the configured secret-store format gives 422 `INVALID_SECRET_REF`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The network identifier.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the version being changed, as returned by the API.

requestBody.description: Token that is cancelled when the client disconnects.

get.summary: Gets the configured retention policies and the protected object types.

put.summary:
Sets the retention of the listed object types. A protected object type (`audit_events`, `evidence`)
is refused with 422 `RETENTION_NOT_ALLOWED`.

requestBody.description: Token that is cancelled when the client disconnects.

Lists the memberships of the current tenant.

parameters.name: Limit

requestBody.description: Token that is cancelled when the client disconnects.

forbiddenLast24Hours.description: Requests answered with 403 (missing permission, no active membership, export policy) in the last 24 hours.

forbiddenLast7Days.description: Requests answered with 403 in the last 7 days.

crossTenantLast24Hours.description: Attempts to reach an object of another tenant (answered with 404) in the last 24 hours.

crossTenantLast7Days.description: Attempts to reach an object of another tenant in the last 7 days.

AccessDeniedSummaryDto.description: Refused requests in the tenant, from the audit trail.

oneOf.description: Gets the scope type: tenant, site or asset.

scopeObjectId.description: Gets the site or asset identifier; omitted for the tenant scope.

AddGrantBody.description: Request body for adding a scope grant to a membership.

subjectId.description: Gets the identity-provider subject identifier (1–256 characters).

oneOf.description: Gets the role; PlatformOperator cannot be assigned.

AddMembershipBody.description: Request body for adding a membership to the caller's tenant.

actor.description: The subject identifier of the actor, or `system`.

action.description: The action name, for example `Edit`, `Export` or `AccessDenied`.

entityId.description: The identifier of the object concerned.

oldState.description: The state before the change as JSON text (masked), or `null`.

newState.description: The state after the change as JSON text (masked), or `null`.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID of the request that caused the event.

causationId.description: The identifier of the event or command that caused this event, if any.

payloadHash.description: The SHA-256 tamper-evidence hash computed over the stored (unmasked) event.

AuditEventDto.description: One audit event as returned by the audit query and export. Credential-like fields in the states are masked.

oneOf.description: Gets the new role; PlatformOperator cannot be assigned.

ChangeMembershipRoleBody.description: Request body for changing the role of a membership.

reason.description: Why the component is not ready or has no check, see UnavailableReasons; empty when ready.

ComponentHealthDto.description: The readiness of one platform component.

residencyPolicy.description: Gets the data-residency policy code (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens); omitted means `unspecified`.

CreateTenantBody.description: Request body for creating a tenant.

credentialRefs.description: The number of credential references set on these networks.

networksWithoutCredentialRef.description: The number of these networks without any credential reference.

lastRotatedAt.description: When a credential reference of these networks was last set (UTC); empty when none is set.

CredentialRefStatusCountDto.description: Credential references of the networks with one status. Counts and dates only, never a reference.

byNetworkStatus.description: The counts per network status, for every status.

lastRotatedAt.description: When any credential reference of the tenant was last set (UTC); empty when none is set.

networks.description: One row per network, ordered by external network identifier.

CredentialRefSummaryDto.description:
The credential references of the tenant's networks: counts per network status, the last rotation and one row per
network. Never contains a reference or a secret.

items.description: The items of this page, in the stable order of the list.

nextCursor.description: The opaque cursor of the next page; `null` when this is the last page.

CursorPageOfAuditEventDto.description: One page of a cursor-paginated list.

items.description: The items of this page, in the stable order of the list.

nextCursor.description: The opaque cursor of the next page; `null` when this is the last page.

CursorPageOfDataNetworkDto.description: One page of a cursor-paginated list.

items.description: The items of this page, in the stable order of the list.

nextCursor.description: The opaque cursor of the next page; `null` when this is the last page.

CursorPageOfMembershipDetailsDto.description: One page of a cursor-paginated list.

items.description: The items of this page, in the stable order of the list.

nextCursor.description: The opaque cursor of the next page; `null` when this is the last page.

CursorPageOfTenantDto.description: One page of a cursor-paginated list.

providerType.description: The provider that serves the network.

tlsMode.description: How the endpoint certificate is verified.

hasCredentialRef.description: Whether a credential reference is set.

updatedAt.description: The time of the last change (UTC).

DataNetworkDto.description: A registered network as returned by the API. It shows whether a credential reference is set, never the reference.

providerType.description: The provider that serves the network.

networkStatus.description: The lifecycle status of the network.

reason.description: Why the provider is not ready or has no check, see UnavailableReasons; empty when ready.

DataProviderHealthDto.description: The readiness of the data provider of one network of the caller's tenant.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, see ErrorCodes.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID of the request.

retriable.description: Whether repeating the same request may succeed.

sourceNetworkId.description: Gets the source network the error relates to, if any.

completeness.description: Gets the data-completeness indication of a partial result, if any.

details.description: Gets non-secret details, for example validation errors per field.

retryAfter.description: Gets the number of seconds after which a retry makes sense, if known.

ErrorEnvelope.description:
The standard error response of the API. Every error is returned in this shape; it never contains stack traces
or secrets.

actor.description: Gets the subject identifier of the actor.

entityType.description: Gets the kind of object, for example `Membership`.

entityId.description: Gets the identifier of the object.

action.description: Gets the action name, for example `Edit` or `AccessDenied`.

correlationId.description: Gets the correlation ID of the request that caused the events.

ExportAuditEventsBody.description: Request body for exporting the audit trail: the file format and the optional filter.

allowedRoles.description: The roles that may export this type; empty when nobody may.

isDefault.description: Whether the tenant has not configured this type and the default applies.

ExportPolicyDto.description: The effective export policy of one export type.

allowedRoles.description:
Gets the roles that may export this type; empty means nobody. Each role must hold the export permission of the
type in the permission matrix.

ExportPolicyEntryBody.description: The requested export policy of one export type.

policies.description: The policies, in a stable order of export type.

ExportPolicySettingsDto.description: The effective export policy of the current tenant, one entry per known export type.

last30Days.description: The number of exports in the last 30 days.

byType.description: The exports per kind of data, ordered by kind.

ExportSummaryDto.description: Data exports of the tenant in the last 30 days, from the audit trail.

exportType.description: The kind of data, for example `audit`.

ExportTypeCountDto.description: The number of exports of one kind of data.

enabled.description: Whether the flag is on for the current tenant.

FeatureFlagDto.description: One feature flag as reported to clients.

items.description: The flags, in a stable order.

GetFeatureFlagsQueryResponse.description: The feature flags of the current tenant: names and on/off only, never configuration details.

GetMembershipByIdQueryResponse.description: One membership of the current tenant.

version.description: The informational version of the application.

serverTimeUtc.description: The current server time in UTC.

GetSystemInfoQueryResponse.description: Non-sensitive information about the running API.

scopeObjectId.description: The site or asset; `null` for the tenant scope.

GrantDto.description: A scope grant that narrows a membership.

GrantScope.description: The kind of object a Grant applies to.

status.description: Whether the figure is available, see MetricStatuses.

reason.description: Why it is not available, see UnavailableReasons; empty when available.

count.description: The number of users without a sign-in within ThresholdDays; empty when not available.

thresholdDays.description: The period that counts as recent, in days; empty when not available.

InactiveUsersDto.description: Users without a recent sign-in. Reported as `not_available` while the platform does not record sign-ins.

grants.description: The scope grants; empty means the whole tenant.

MembershipDetailsDto.description: A membership with its scope grants, as returned by the membership administration endpoints.

MembershipDto.description: A membership as returned by tenancy queries.

status.description: The lifecycle status of the network.

hasCredentialRef.description: Whether a credential reference is set.

credentialRotatedAt.description: When the most recent credential reference was set (UTC); empty when none is set.

NetworkCredentialDto.description: Whether a network has a credential reference and when it was last set. The reference itself is never returned.

status.description: Whether the figure is available, see MetricStatuses.

reason.description: Why it is not available, see UnavailableReasons; empty when available.

failingNetworks.description: The number of networks with a failing health check; empty when not available.

NetworkHealthSummaryDto.description:
Networks whose data provider fails its health check. Reported as `not_available` while network health checks
do not exist.

NetworkProviderType.description: The kind of data provider that serves a registered network. Provenance only: the domain holds no provider payloads.

oneOf.description: Gets the provider that serves the network.

endpointUrl.description:
Gets the endpoint URL: HTTPS (plain HTTP only to a loopback host in Development), without user information,
query or fragment, and its host and port must be in the allowlist.

endpointAllowlist.description: Gets the allowed endpoints as `host:port` (IPv6 as `[address]:port`), 1–20 entries.

oneOf.description: Gets how the endpoint certificate is verified.
Gets the status: draft or active (the live provider only while its feature flag is on).

NetworkSettingsBody.description: Request body for replacing the settings of a network. All values are required.

NetworkStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a registered network.

NetworkTlsMode.description: How the TLS certificate of a network endpoint is verified. Disabling verification is not an option.

externalNetworkId.description:
Gets the tenant-chosen network identifier (for example `net-a`): 1–64 lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_'
or '-', unique in the tenant and immutable.

oneOf.description: Gets the provider that serves the network.

endpointUrl.description:
Gets the endpoint URL: HTTPS (plain HTTP only to a loopback host in Development), without user information,
query or fragment, and its host and port must be in the allowlist.

endpointAllowlist.description: Gets the allowed endpoints as `host:port` (IPv6 as `[address]:port`), 1–20 entries.

oneOf.description: Gets how the endpoint certificate is verified.
Gets the status: draft or active (the live provider only while its feature flag is on).

RegisterNetworkBody.description: Request body for registering a network.

retentionDays.description: The agreed retention term in days, or `null` when no term is agreed (keep indefinitely).

RetentionPolicyDto.description: The configured retention of one object type. Stored and shown only: nothing is removed on the basis of it.

objectType.description:
Gets the object type code (lowercase letters, digits, underscores). `audit_events` and `evidence` are
protected and refused.

retentionDays.description: Gets the agreed retention term in days, or `null` when no term is agreed (keep indefinitely).

legalHold.description: Gets a value indicating whether a legal hold applies.

RetentionPolicyEntryBody.description: The requested retention of one object type. The setting is stored and shown only; nothing is removed by it.

policies.description: The configured policies, ordered by object type.

protectedObjectTypes.description: Object types that are never removed and cannot get a retention policy.

RetentionPolicySettingsDto.description: The retention settings of the current tenant.

RoleMembershipCountDto.description: The memberships of one role in the tenant.

usersByRole.description: The memberships per role, for every role.

credentialRefs.description: The credential references of the networks.

networkHealth.description: Networks with a failing health check.

retention.description: The retention settings per object type (stored and shown only, not enforced).

exports.description: Data exports in the last 30 days.

SecurityOverviewDto.description:
Security and privacy figures of one tenant for its administrators. Contains counts, dates and names only: never a
secret, a credential reference or a figure of another tenant. A figure without a data source is marked
`not_available` instead of being estimated.

components.description: The platform components (API, database, job host).

dataProviders.description: The data provider per network of the caller's tenant, ordered by external network identifier.

ServiceHealthDto.description:
The readiness of the platform services. A component without a readiness check is reported as
`not_available`; nothing is claimed about it.

secretRef.description:
Gets the reference to the secret, in the format of the configured secret store
(`openbao:<tenant path><path>[#field]`).

oneOf.description: Gets what the credential is used for (default authentication).

SetCredentialRefBody.description:
Request body for setting the credential reference of a network. The reference points to a secret in the secret
store; never send the secret itself. The reference is write-only: no response ever contains it.

TenantDto.description: A tenant as returned by the tenant administration endpoints.

policies.description: Gets the policies to set, at most one per export type.

UpdateExportPolicyBody.description: Request body for setting the export policy of one or more export types; types not listed keep their policy.

policies.description: Gets the policies to set, at most one per object type.

UpdateRetentionPolicyBody.description: Request body for setting the retention of one or more object types; object types not listed keep their setting.

name.description: Gets the new display name (1–200 characters).

residencyPolicy.description: Gets the new data-residency policy code.

oneOf.description: Gets the new status: active, or suspended (the tenant's members lose access immediately).

UpdateTenantBody.description: Request body for changing a tenant. Omitted values stay unchanged.
